- The proof sources show `entry` importing and using `Public`, and [model.ts](/private/tmp/loci-r1-availability-ujjoju0f/availability-integrated/workspace/model.ts) defining `Public` as `Middle`.

The semantic result is bounded and non-exhaustive; its selection omitted one candidate.
